A great tour with an exceptional guide

My wife and I had a very enjoyable visit to the Observatory Roque
Muchachos. Our guide was friendly, knowledgeable and we think she pitched the information at just the right level. I am a bit of an astronomy nerd, and my wife definitely isn't, but we both learned a lot and gained from the experience. She did a
great job!
You definitely need to book in advance for this popular tour; don't leave it to the last minute. The drive up from Santa Cruz take a bit longer than Google maps may suggest - I recommend allowing around 1h30. The views on the way up are spectacular, and are even better from the top. As many have said, it's at least 10°C colder at the top, so take warm clothes. You'll also need to take water to drink - the humidity up there is around 1% and the water will help you avoid the effects of altitude sickness.

The views from the summit of Roque de los Muchachos are spectacular. You can drive there but we went on a coach trip that included going inside the building that houses the GTC telescope, the largest optical telescope in the World, with the specialist guide Sheila. (Wear warm clothes as it is about 8,000 feet high though it was OK when we went - early Feb.)

extract.description: Le Instituto de Astrofisica de Canarias est un observatoire astrophysique situé au sommet du Roque de Los Muchachos. C'est un lieu prisé pour les visites guidées et l'apprentissage sur des sujets astrophysiques.
extract.adresse: Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos, Apartado de Correos 50, Breña Baja, 38712, La Palma, Spain
extract.avis_utilisateurs_synthese: Les visiteurs apprécient la qualité des visites guidées, le fond pédagogique et les vues spectaculaires sur les paysages environnants. Il est recommandé de réserver à l'avance et de porter des vêtements chauds en raison de l'altitude.
